span.p: Session authentication: cookie token to SHA-256 lookup, fixed expiry

span.p: Zod validation; unknown query keys rejected

span.p: Ownership scope: authorId taken only from the session; foreign ids answer 404

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PostgreSQL on an internal-only network;
triggers enforce book/author match and ADMIN-only assignees

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Uploads: size/type checks, stored outside web root,
served as forced downloads, traversal names neutralised

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AI boundary: provider output is untrusted,
validated against shared schema, never sends anything

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Secrets: env only (SESSION_SECRET, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, OPENROUTER_API_KEY).
API refuses placeholder secrets in production. Argon2id password hashes.
